target.topic_name: Collapse of Thailand State Audit Office building
target.source_page: Collapse of Thailand State Audit Office building

card.fact_statement: The Ministry of Labour announced it would provide compensation for relatives of those who died in the collapse.
card.source_span: The Ministry of Labour announced that it would provide up to two million baht in compensation for relatives of each those who died
aliases: Collapse of Thailand State Audit Office building
